arguments.hindsight: I misjudged peg alignment from oblique views and released pieces before confirming insertion. Cross-arm interference and repeated unreachable retreats consumed many actions. Future attempts should establish an unobstructed peg-tip view, verify each piece is fully seated, and keep the idle arm outside the carrying path.
arguments.reason: I could not reliably seat the pieces on their pegs or complete the task within the remaining action budget.
